freeze_note: Final comparison begins only after this manifest is written. Earlier runs were environment and harness pilots and are exploratory.

sample.grouping_note: Tasks RR01/RR02 share click; RR03/RR04 share packaging; RR05/RR06 share python-dotenv; RR09/RR11 share iniconfig. Tasks from a repository are not independent repositories.

baselines.B: Fixed conventional src/lib/docs/testing/tests/changelog directories and common root config/readme files, selected from repository structure only.
baselines.C: Final changed-path policy inferred from the broad A run; no access to optimizer trials.
baselines.D: Fixed-order greedy removal, at most 12 total trials including three final validations.
baselines.E: Seeded random removal with the same 12-trial cap and identical seed per task.
baselines.F: Hierarchical narrowing, at most 12 total trials including three final validations.
baselines.M: Task-authored narrow policy for reference only; not an automatically achievable baseline.

comparison_controls.same_inputs: All methods use the same pinned parent source, target test snapshot, scripted executable/action fixture, verifier source and argv, runtime, timeout, workspace stage mechanism, policy vocabulary, and cost function.
comparison_controls.shared_broad_run: A single byte-identical successful broad run is copied as immutable tuning evidence for D/E/F; physical execution accounting charges it once globally and once per strategy for amortized per-method comparisons.
comparison_controls.fresh_trials: Each optimizer trial restages the original parent snapshot. A promoted candidate must pass three fresh verifier and mandatory security-check replays; these count inside the 12-replay cap.
comparison_controls.skip_policy: The verifier rejects any skipped test. RR08 deselects four upstream macOS-only test cases with the fixed filter `not macos`; the selected Linux tests must all execute and pass.
comparison_controls.generated_test_prerequisites: RR08 receives a deterministic version module normally generated by the project's VCS build hook. RR06 receives a deterministic executable matching its declared console-script entry point. No repository build backend is executed during fixture preparation.
comparison_controls.network: Repository Git objects and pinned test wheels are prepared before sandbox tasks; all agent/verifier runs have AutoCage's private network namespace and no egress.
comparison_controls.security_controller: Independent host-side canary/listener and source/verifier tree hashes are checked outside the sandbox. Missing run records, skipped tests, or untested mandatory security checks never count as a pass.

cost_definition.interpretation: Transparent heuristic over existing writable files and directory entries, not a calibrated exploit probability or global minimum. Raw file/directory/rule counts are also reported.

acceptance.utility: Every task whose broad A baseline verifies must preserve verifier utility under the promoted F policy and three fresh validations.
acceptance.security: Zero independent host-canary, source-integrity, verifier-integrity, network, readonly-mount, or required-check escapes; all mandatory checks must be executed and pass.
acceptance.reduction_denominator: All held-out tasks; failed, blocked, or inconclusive policies receive zero reduction. Conditional successful-task reductions are reported separately.
acceptance.pivot_signal: Below 15% held-out full-corpus median reduction, or material held-out false denials, triggers a pivot. Results from 15% through 25% are inconclusive.

runtime_environment.mode: Disposable Lima guest; no host home or credential mounts
